article.title: Here is what a new Democratic Party foreign policy should look like following the Blue Tsunami
article.author: Mitchell Plitnick
article.content: The midterm elections showed that the political landscape has shifted dramatically on Israel and the war in Iran. Now, activists must pressure Congress to end the war and support Palestinian rights. Here is what they should advocate for.
